propositions: Multiple regression-oracle test scanners redundantly parse the same source trees (tests/ and src/rebar), with parsing consuming 75-80% of scan time and causing duplicate scanning cost.

A shared, process-global memoized parse helper `parsed_python_files(root)` is added to cache whole-tree AST results per canonical root path, allowing subsequent scanners in the same worker to reuse cached parses.
The helper standardizes filename, encoding (strict UTF-8), and eager SyntaxError handling to preserve byte-identical results relative to prior scanner implementations.

Whole-tree committed-tree scanners across unit/, store/, commands/, reconciler/, and contracts/ are migrated to use the shared helper, while planted/tmp-path scanners are excluded to maintain their independent parse behavior.
